purpose: Narrow first-use capability that serializes on one active Account and materializes exactly one fresh self Person plus Account application context when absent, without granting generic runtime Person creation.

routine.return_type: TABLE(account_ref uuid, self_person_ref uuid, timezone_mode text, fixed_zone_id text)

state_history.current_binding: Returns the one Account application-context row after serializing first-use creation.
state_history.immutability_policy: The capability either returns existing state or creates the one initial context; it is not a generic mutation surface.

lifecycle.delete_behavior: Dropped only by migration downgrade after revoking direct runtime execution; downgrade intentionally does not delete already minted Person identities.

obligations: runtime generic INSERT on Person remains denied
Account row locking serializes concurrent first use
an existing context is returned without creating the caller's discarded candidate Person
only active Accounts and application-issued UUIDv7 self Person references are accepted
PUBLIC and dante_migrator have no direct EXECUTE
